 1. From the "TableView" worksheet, filter out all record rows where the subject is "Information Technology"
 2. Fill the filtered results into the "小学Information Technology" worksheet according to the existing column structure and format of that worksheet (append after existing data; if the sheet is empty, start from the first row)

 - If the remarks do not contain the keyword or the remarks are empty, leave that column blank (do not fill in any content)
 4. For other columns (such as teacher name, school name, etc.), copy directly from the corresponding columns in "TableView"
 5. Preserve the header format (font, color, borders, etc.) of the "小学Information Technology" worksheet in the original file
6. After completing the above operations, generate a new file
